content.short_description: IFM-IG5599 is an M18 threaded-barrel inductive proximity sensor with an 8 mm sensing range, PNP discrete output, and nickel plated brass housing rated IP68K9.
content.long_description:
The ifm electronic IFM-IG5599 is an inductive proximity sensor housed in an M18 threaded barrel format with a nickel plated brass housing. It detects metallic targets within an 8 mm measuring range and outputs a PNP discrete signal for direct interface with PLC inputs and other sourcing-logic control systems.

Supply voltage is rated 10-30 VDC, covering common industrial control voltage ranges including 12 VDC and 24 VDC systems. Response time is 1.5 ms, suitable for detection tasks requiring fast switching cycles.

The housing carries an IP68K9 ingress protection rating, indicating protection against continuous immersion and high-pressure, high-temperature washdown conditions. The M18 threaded barrel process connection allows mounting into standard M18 tapped bores or mounting brackets using threaded nuts.

This sensor is applicable in metalworking, automotive, food and beverage, and other environments where washdown resistance and reliable metallic target detection are required.
